# Soft Shine Cosmetic

> Soft Shine Cosmetic is a beauty and makeup products wholesale business in Veraval, Gujarat, connecting beauty businesses with products and curated beauty expos.

This is a one-page public website. Expo registration is available through the homepage and successful registrations receive downloadable PDF tickets with QR codes.

## Public site

- [Homepage](/): About the business, active expos, contact details, sponsors, and registration flow.
- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): Indexable public URLs.
- [Robots](/robots.txt): Crawler access rules.

## Optional

- [Full business context](/llms-full.txt): More detailed information about the business, expo, registration, and contact flow.
